create_fov_perspective_camera: create a FoVPerspectiveCamera with field of view, near/far clipping planes, and rotation/translation extrinsics
create_perspective_sfm_camera: create a PerspectiveCamera using focal length, principal point, and rotation/translation for multi-view geometry
transform_3d_points: transform 3D points from world coordinates to NDC or screen space using a camera projection
unproject_camera_points: unproject 2D points with depth from screen or NDC space back to world or camera coordinates
compute_look_at_transform: compute rotation and translation matrices for a look-at camera given position, target, and up vector
